items.html: And behold, in the first three months, the first of Hochma, which is the principal one, is completed, and therefore then is when the fetus becomes recognizable, as above; and the other two, in the other six months — behold, they are three membranes of the sparks, which are three Elohim in the nine months of pregnancy alone, in the manner above, for the name Elohim in gematria is 86, which are approximately the days of three months. And the phase of the Mochin themselves is the lights, as above.
